Lumen Brand Guidelines

Color

Primary Blue #0071E3 — Pantone 2175 C — CMYK 100 45 0 0

Graphite #1D1D1F

Silver #F5F5F7

Signal Red #FF3B30

Use no more than 2 colors per layout, plus neutrals.

Typography

Typeface: Helvetica Neue

Headlines must always be set in Helvetica Neue Bold.

Body text: Helvetica Neue Regular 17px.

The minimum text size is 12px for any legal or caption text.

Never set headlines in uppercase.

Spacing

All spacing uses an 8px grid.

Imagery

Photography should always show the product on a seamless light background.

Avoid busy backgrounds and props that compete with the product.
